answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The haven edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 75 clones produces a signature the whisper analysis flags immediately. An attacker must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, and therefore doing work rather than printing keys, and the raven settlement applies the void retroactively. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
